text:
anna: Quick update — CobaltGrid is ready to go with the case draft except one line in the quote. They want 'latency' called out as p99 tail latency and the percent anonymized.
dylan: Can you paste the verbatim quote they want published? Legal wants exact wording before sign-off.
anna: Their Head of ML suggested: "Redwood cut our p99 tail latency by ~60% and lowered per-token costs by about half."
mei: Legal redlines: change '~60%' -> 'approximately 60%'; change 'about half' -> 'approximately 50%'. Need explicit logo usage permission plus a signed quote release (email confirmation is fine). No raw ARR or revenue figures in the piece.
noah: Ops question 1: webinar dates 11 we have two slots: Apr 22 11:00 ET or Apr 23 11:00 ET. Prefers Apr 23 for PM availability. Panel: CobaltGrid CTO + Redwood PM (20 mins + 10 Q&A).
priya: I'll set landing page with hidden field campaign=cobaltgrid and route inbound leads to EMEA_AE queue, tagging @ali for follow-up. Also set nurture to 3 emails pre/post.
ali: Confirmed on the routing. Please map demo signups to SF campaign CG-2026 and set lead owner rule for EMEA West.
anna: I'll ask CobaltGrid comms to send the approval email with the exact publish date and attach logo (svg) + headshot. I'll also request permission to record the session.
mei: Also request they confirm we won't quote any absolute customer revenue or MRR. An anonymized ARR band is acceptable if they want context.
dylan: Design plan: I'll prepare a neutral hero slide titled 'Inference at scale: cost & latency' and keep the logo placeholder until approval. Slide deck + onepager ready 48hrs before webinar.
noah: calendar-bot: Event created  "CobaltGrid webinar prep" Apr 23 11:00 ET  invites sent to anna,dylan,mei,ali,priya
calendar-bot: Recording & transcript enabled (Zoom).
anna: Checklist in doc: 1) Legal-approved quote text (anna/mei) 2) Email approval + logo permission (anna) 3) Assets uploaded (logo, headshot) (cobaltgrid contact) 4) Slides & one-pager (dylan) 5) Landing page + lead routing (priya/ali) 6) SF campaign mapping (ali) 7) Recording & post-edit (noah)  Target publish window: Apr 29 (post-webinar)
priya: Ops note: I'll set the lead form hidden field and schedule nurture start on Apr 21 pending legal greenlight.
mei: On standby for the final quote sign-off. If we get the email by Apr 20 EOD, legal can sign off for Apr 29 publish. :thumbsup:
anna: Thanks y'all  I'll keep this thread updated once comms replies. :pray:
